texts.name: Seymour
texts.biography: Seymour has been repeatedly mistaken for Kastore because of his appearance and the fact that he has access to a portable replicator. Thanks to the latter, he is able to supply reinforcements outside the armories of the Heavenly Forge.

specialty.name: Forge
specialty.description:
{Forge}

Can upgrade goblins, hobgoblins, walking dead, zombies, gogs and magogs to Forge t1 - t3 creatures.

texts.name: Deckard
texts.biography: Deckard's state-of-the-art heavy armor fully lives up to its expectations. The mere sight of this impregnable cyborg on the battlefield can fill his troops with strength to weather the onslaught of bullets and blows.

specialty.description:
{Armorer}

Receives a 5% per level bonus to Armorer skill percentage.
specialty.name: Armorer

texts.name: Charity
texts.biography: After the Succession Wars, Charity left the continent of Enroth, lusting after more excitement and conflict. Eventually, she was attracted to the roaring call of the Heavenly Forge, like a moth drawn to the flame.

specialty.description:
{Sorcery}

Receives a 5% per level bonus to Sorcery skill percentage.
specialty.name: Sorcery

texts.name: Everest
texts.biography: Everest was banished from Bracada for taking over wizads' golems and other animated servants. In the more turbulent circles of Techno Junkies, his impulses stopped sparking controversy, allowing him to perfect the art of controlling magical constructs.

specialty.description:
{Mysticism}

Receives a 5% per level bonus to Mysticism skill percentage.
specialty.name: Mysticism

texts.name: Sheikleen
texts.biography: Enigmas like Sheikleen are not uncommon in the ranks of the Heavenly Forge. She emerged one day among the chain of command and her directives won battles, so she was universally deemed a useful asset. Still, there's always an ulterior motive with these kind of people.

specialty.description:
{Intelligence}

Receives a 5% per level bonus to Intelligence skill percentage.
specialty.name: Intelligence

texts.name: Cistrict
texts.biography: Cistrict's abilities and great ambition brought upon him the wrath of many Nighon Warlocks. When the Heavenly Forge blazed anew, he found himself before its gates, to seek restoration of the body ravaged by magic duels.

specialty.description:
{Interference}

Receives a 5% per level bonus to Interference skill percentage.
specialty.name: Interference
